data.title: Gavin Newsom Won't Run Against Kamala Harris in 2028, Says the Fight Would Be: 'Mutual Assured Destruction'
data.description: Newsom says he won’t seek the 2028 Democratic nomination if Kamala Harris runs, warning their overlapping support would help Republicans.

data.title: Donald Trump Jr. Needed 2 Islands and Fireworks, Says Hunter Biden, as Lavish Bahamas Party Faces Scrutiny Over Putin-Linked Russian Oligarch
data.description: Donald Trump Jr. and Bettina Trump say a Putin-linked Russian businessman’s lavish Bahamas celebration was simply a wedding gift.

data.title: Elizabeth Warren Says Trump Is First President to 'Own' a Bank, Calls for an End to 'Crypto Corruption' Amid CLARITY Act Buzz
data.description: Sen. Elizabeth Warren rejected the final CLARITY Act text on Monday, September 14, adding that it does nothing to stop President Donald Trump's cryptocurrency profiteering.

data.title: Elon Musk Fuels Tesla-SpaceX Merger Talks Again, Says, 'Imagine What Action One Might Take…’
data.description: Elon Musk reignites talks of a possible Tesla-SpaceX merger, citing deep collaboration between the two companies.

data.title: No Prenup, $930 Million on the Line: Lululemon Founder Chip Wilson's Divorce Could Reshape His Stake in the Company
data.description: Chip Wilson’s divorce puts his 8.7% Lululemon stake under scrutiny, but other assets could help avoid a sale amid weaker sales.
